data.description:
## What
Create plugins/dso/scripts/sprint/check-recipe-engines.sh — a bash helper that scans the sprint task list for recipe: tasks and validates that each referenced engine is installed and meets the minimum version requirement from the registry.

## Why
TDD GREEN phase: implement the engine check script to make RED tests from e7a1-c98a pass.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Script exists at plugins/dso/scripts/sprint/check-recipe-engines.sh and is executable
- Accepts: --task-list=<file-path> (JSON array of task descriptions, or can scan --task-dir=<dir>)
- Scans tasks for ## Testing Mode lines matching recipe:* pattern
- For each unique recipe name found: reads registry to get engine name and min_engine_version
- Engine presence check: runs command -v <engine> (rope → python3 -c 'import rope', isort → isort --version, ts-morph → node -e 'require("ts-morph")')
- Version check: extracts version string and compares semver against min_engine_version
- Output lines:
  - NO_RECIPE_TASKS — no recipe: tasks found (no-op)
  - ENGINES_OK — all engines present and version-compatible
  - MISSING_ENGINE: <engine> minimum:<version> — for each missing engine
  - OUTDATED_ENGINE: <engine> found:<version> minimum:<version> — for each outdated engine
  - Final line: MISSING_ENGINES_LIST=<comma-separated engine list> (empty when all OK; consumed by S5 fallback)
- RECIPE_REGISTRY_PATH and TASK_LIST_FILE env vars injectable for test isolation
- All tests in test-check-recipe-engines.sh pass

## File Impact
- CREATE: plugins/dso/scripts/sprint/check-recipe-engines.sh

## Testing Mode
GREEN — make failing tests pass

## Dependencies
- e7a1-c98a (RED tests must exist first)
